text.text: Hiyaa-Vehi starts from a block of identical 25-storey towers, where 32,000 people share 12 ha with little shade and little reason to be outdoors. The plan houses 11,800; the other 20,200 move to a new development elsewhere in the Greater Malé Region.
Hiyaa-Vehi masterplan. Numbers refer to the legend.

The plan gives the block a centre. Buildings sit on the nodes where paths cross, a radial plan gathers them round a central plaza and park, and no path runs straight, so movement slows. Vehicles keep to the perimeter, and the ground between the homes is given back to people.
